Rivet overrides

  1. Open any page and click the bookmark to apply the overrides; click again to remove them.
  2. The CSS comes from the pushed copy of dist/overrides.bundle.css on GitHub (main); after changes, rebuild, commit and push, then click twice (off, on). GitHub may cache for a few minutes.

Mode: GitHub (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NouveauReece/Springshare-to-Rivet/refs/heads/main/dist/overrides.bundle.css). Pages with a strict Content-Security-Policy can block injected styles.
